summary: A day dominated by major Reliance moves and retail sector momentum. Jio Platforms' imminent $3.8B IPO at $114B valuation headlines, while Kalyan Jewellers reports 26% Q2 revenue growth ahead of festive season.

bullets.text: Jio Platforms IPO launches October 21 seeking $114 billion valuation with $3.8 billion fundraise.
Kalyan Jewellers Q2 consolidated revenue surged 26% with India business growing 27% ahead of festive season.
Foreign investors pulled $26.3 billion from emerging markets in September as hawkish Fed pushed US Treasury yields higher.
Korea's CJ Foods enters India with Bibigo Bapsang; targets Rs 100 crore revenue and 100 outlets by June 2027.
India's quick commerce market projected to grow seven-fold to USD 90 billion by FY31, up from current valuations.
